answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted identity bonding: every agent must lock a deposit that scales with the influence it claims, so a sybil fleet needs real capital instead of free keys. Picture a terrace of accounts rising above the ocean, where the higher the seat, the deeper the opal of collateral sunk beneath it. One fake identity is cheap, but a thousand coordinated ones must each fund the same bond, and slashed stakes make the whole voyage unprofitable.
